facts.fact: Carson 在傍晚六点半（six thirty）前换了四次裙子（four times），并两次（twice）认真考虑取消与 Beau 的约会。
facts.anchor: By six thirty that evening, I had changed my dress four times and seriously considered canceling my date with Beau twice.

facts.fact: 二十分钟后（Twenty minutes later），Beau 开车驶入 Willow Creek 另一边的一条住宅街（quiet residential street）。
facts.anchor: Twenty minutes later, he turned into a quiet residential street on the other side of Willow Creek.

facts.fact: Beau 没有带 Carson 去镇上的约会地点，而是把她带到了他自己家。
facts.anchor: You brought me to your house.

facts.fact: Carson 意识到自己穿着一件五年（five years）没碰过的裙子坐在 Beau 家里，而她的咖啡奶精就放在他的冰箱里。
facts.anchor: And somehow, I was sitting in his house wearing a dress I hadn’t touched in five years while my coffee creamer waited in his refrigerator.

facts.fact: Beau 与 Carson 聊了将近两个小时（almost two hours），没谈事故、牧场债务，也没问她是否还好。
facts.anchor: We talked for almost two hours. Not about the accident. Not about ranch debt. Not about whether I was okay.

facts.fact: 三个晚上前（Three nights ago），Carson 在 Beau 面前取下假肢曾像站在聚光灯下赤身一样；今晚她只是让自己舒服。
facts.anchor: Three nights ago, removing it in front of Beau had felt like standing naked beneath a spotlight.

facts.fact: Beau 请 Carson 留下过夜，并用 Carson, you’re twenty-five.（你二十五岁了）回应她对 Meme 会知道的担心。
一个月前（A month ago），Beau 还是汽车店里站着的陌生男人；次日早晨他在厨房煮了 Carson 喜欢的咖啡和薄烤饼。
facts.anchor: A month ago, Beau had been a stranger standing in an automotive shop while I dripped rainwater onto his floor.
